gold_points: Two reportable segments: management and franchise, and ownership
Management and franchise earns management fees, franchise fees, and IP licensing fees from HGV and partnerships
Franchise fees cover brand use plus reservation, marketing and IT services
Ownership earns from room sales, food and beverage, and other services at owned and leased hotels
output.note: Segment description starts in the first chunk and finishes in the second, so both are needed for full coverage.
output.question: How did Hilton Worldwide Holdings describe its two reportable segments and the ways each generates revenue in its fiscal 2021 10-K?
